content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in the early part of the forecast horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices when the true outcome shows strong upward momentum or volatility.
- Tends to lag behind true price movements, particularly in the 10–20 day range.
- Overreacts to short-term volatility, overshooting peaks and failing to capture mean reversion.
- Fails to adjust for seasonal or cyclical patterns in the 30-day window, especially when prices are trending upward.
- Underestimates the magnitude of price corrections after sharp spikes.
- Shows persistent bias toward lower values when the true outcome is above 65–70, suggesting underconfidence in upward momentum.
- Overestimates the persistence of recent trends, failing to account for mean reversion in the 15–25 day window.
